references.context: Use the Star Map to start chapters and collect skull values.
references.label: Star Map
references.description: Central magnet-and-target assembly that chooses a qualified chapter color.

references.context: Shoot the Chest for Dead Man's Chest locks and its Super Jackpot.
references.label: Dead Man's Chest
references.description: Center-left orbit and physical lock guarded by two green targets.

references.context: Shoot Maelstrom to start At World's End and collect its Jackpot.
references.label: Maelstrom
references.description: Tight left ramp surrounding the whirlpool mechanism.

references.context: Shoot the right saucer to start Tortuga Multiball.
references.label: Tortuga saucer
references.description: Right-side saucer that starts Tortuga after enough gold is collected.
